images.title: Three things we found
images.purpose: A clean summary of three findings: a sign switch changes the result by an even amount, divisible by two numbers means divisible by their LCM, and every place value is a multiple of 9 plus 1.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. Three equal cards in a row, each with a heading and one short line.
images.exact_structure: Three equal rounded cards side by side with thin outlines in teal (#0072B2), amber (#E69F00) and reddish purple (#CC79A7). Card 1 heading parity, line changes by 2b. Card 2 heading LCM, line 6 and 4 give 12. Card 3 heading place value, line 10 = 9 + 1. Exactly 3 cards. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Parity, the LCM rule and place value remainders explain the chapter's patterns.
